book: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
title: Tea with Mr. Tumnus
brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into Narnia. In Chapter 2, Mr. Tumnus invites Lucy to tea in his cave. Build the tea, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is Mr. Tumnus’s cave, from Chapter 2. He promised Lucy “a roaring fire – and toast – and sardines – and cake.”

models.name: Small Chair
models.why: “one for me and one for a friend”

models.name: Toast Loaf
models.why: sardines on toast, toast with honey

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put the **fire** by a wall and the **table** near it. Add **two chairs**. Put the **toast** and **cup** on the table.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “Mr. Tumnus seems kind because ___. But he has a secret: ___.”
steps.text: Sit in a chair and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Sit in a chair and say this out loud. Mr. Tumnus seems kind because… But he has a secret…

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: the fire, the table, two chairs, the toast and the cup

extra.text: Add an **HTKAM - Literature Book** for Mr. Tumnus’s shelf. Make up a title and say it.

points: Your photo shows the fire, the table, two chairs, the toast and the cup in the cave.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each clue from the book and tap the thing it names. Then finish two sentences about Lucy and Mr. Tumnus.
mapday.done: ✓ You found every one. Now finish the two sentences.

scene.aria: Mr. Tumnus’s cave, with a spot for each thing from the book

clues.q: “…she reached it and found it was a lamp-post.”
“…he carried over his head an umbrella, white with snow.”
“…sardines on toast, and then buttered toast…”
“…a strange little flute that looked as if it were made of straw…”
